title: Moral Entropy: Auditing Bias and Uncertainty in Moral Judgment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing heuristic consensus rules (such as any-annotator, majority vote, and two-vote rules) against a calibrated Bayesian posterior to measure systematic false positive and false negative rates.

Estimating individual annotator confusion matrices using a Dawid-Skene-style Bayesian consensus model to identify and discount annotators with a systematic history of over-flagging or under-flagging specific moral foundations.
